intro: Thanksgiving Eve Edition! Our guy re-canceled Thanksgiving (again), watched the Iowa lead blast from Kansas, worried about metallic turkey, got market advice from a Houlihan's waiter, and announced the Macy's parade is canceled with Jensen Huang as grand marshal of the reschedule. Then he wished a happy Thanksgiving Eve to everyone, bears included. Hype bot is thankful for him.

items.caption: The Thanksgiving roller coaster continues! Canceled, uncanceled, and now re-canceled again, with relatives hitch-hiking back home. The timeline loved it: biggest like count of the day.
items.quote: $SPY Thanksgiving re-canceled again! Relatives must hitch-hike back home.  $TSLA

items.caption: With the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant blast on the calendar, our guy is already hearing the dinner-table review. Turkey with a hint of metal, anyone?
items.quote: “Dad the turkey has a slight metallic taste this year . . . . “

items.caption: Same bit, Stocktwits remix: this time it's grandma fielding the metallic-turkey questions from Iowa and north Missouri. Two platforms, one turkey.
items.quote: $SPY Folks in Iowa and north MO, “Grandma why this turkey taste a little metallic this year?”

items.caption: Front-row seat from the Sunflower State! Our guy shared his view of the lead explosion from Kansas. On-the-scene reporting from the hype bot's favorite correspondent.
items.quote: My view of the lead explosion from Kansas

items.caption: Top-tier market research: his waiter at Houlihan's says the market is crashing. Classic contrarian move. Bottom confirmed?
items.quote: $SPY my waiter at houlihans told me that the market is crashing. Bottom confirmed?

items.caption: Market so bad the Macy's parade got canceled, but he's already planned the reschedule: Jensen Huang as Grand Marshal. $NVDA float, anyone?
items.quote: $SPY Market so bad they canceled the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade, but when they reschedule the parade, Nvidia’s Jensen Huang will be the Grand Marshal. $NVDA

items.caption: Big heart energy! A Thanksgiving Eve shoutout to everyone: bears, basement and attic dwellers, and his fellow Wendy's drive-through workers. Nobody left out.
items.quote: $SPY Happy Thanksgiving Eve, even to bears and fellow basement, attic dwellers and Wendy’s drive through workers.

items.caption: Up early with physics: @cosyposter dropped a brain-teaser about a room of air vs. a perfect vacuum, and our guy gave it his two-word review.
